title: Shader Tools variant catalog
description: Named shader compilation contexts selectable in Visual Studio.

name.description: Display name. Names must be unique for each shader file.

file.description: Shader file. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root.

entryPoint.description: Function compiled as the shader entry point.

defines.description: Preprocessor symbols used for this variant.

includes.description: Additional include directories, resolved from the workspace root.

stage.description: Shader stage. Use auto or null to let the language server infer it from the filename.
